d:
Is Sri Krishna still relevant in the 21st century? What can his teachings tell us about fear, failure, loneliness, overthinking and the pressure to constantly “win” in life?
In this video, we explore the modern struggles that many of us face through the lens of Shri Krishna’s philosophy. From Andre Agassi’s battle with shame and insecurity to the changing nature of friendships, we look at how Maya, Bhaya and the idea of “Leela” can help us understand our own inner battles.
